label: D1 after an unrewarded a1 -> S1 (common) trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and only when the reward input is 0. Within that, it is specific to the previous trial having been a1 with a common transition to S1: unrewarded at S1 reached via a1. After a1->S2 rare it essentially never fires, and after a2 it rarely fires (a2->S1 rare gives only weak activations). All variables are observed. Dev F1 0.80, precision 0.77, recall 0.82, mass recall 0.83, with coverage about equal across activation quartiles. Most misses are at the window first D1 (rel -3), where prev_action is unknown in the data even though the agent saw it. Adding that case raises mass recall to 0.99 but drops precision to 0.45. The false positives are mostly a1-S1c-unrewarded D1s where the agent then switches to a2. Adding the upcoming choice action==1 raises precision to 0.90 but cuts recall to 0.67 (F1 0.77), so the base predicate was recorded. Activation is confined to the model policy-logit range of about -1.5 to 8 (mild a1 preference) and the value range below 7.73. This is consistent with a signal that S1 was just unrewarded while the agent still leans toward a1. I did not establish what modulates its magnitude.
